fields.name: text
fields.description: Text in the cell. If omitted, then the cell is invisible.

fields.name: is_header
fields.description: _True_, if the cell is a header cell

fields.name: colspan
fields.description: The number of columns the cell spans if it is bigger than 1

fields.name: rowspan
fields.description: The number of rows the cell spans if it is bigger than 1

fields.name: align
fields.description: Horizontal cell content alignment. Currently, must be one of “left”, “center”, or “right”.

fields.name: valign
fields.description: Vertical cell content alignment. Currently, must be one of “top”, “middle”, or “bottom”.
